text:
{{Card |title=Attack Run |publication_id=decipher-reflections-attack-run-foil-en |image=Reflections-Foil-L-Attack-Run-PSA-72605733-original.jpg |image_note=Reflections foil, photographed in a grading holder. |side=Light |type=Epic Event |set=Reflections |language=en |language_display=English |border_finish=Foil |release=January 2000 |publisher=[[Decipher]] |era=[[Decipher era]] |rarity=VR |rarity_link=Rarity |uniqueness=Unique |set_icon=[[File:Icon-set-A-New-Hope.png|20px|link=A New Hope]] [[A New Hope]] |destiny=0 |icons=[[Epic Event]] |extra_info=Original expansion[[A New Hope]]Publication IDdecipher-reflections-attack-run-foil-en |version_label=Reflections foil |set_band=Decipher |navigation=[[Reflections]] · [[Attack Run|Earlier non-foil printing]] |lead='''Attack Run''' is a [[Light]] [[Epic Event]] released as a very-rare foil in [[Reflections]] in January 2000.[https://res.starwarsccg.org/Resources/swccgcardlist4.0.pdf Complete Card List v4.0], pp. 28–32 (collecting compilation). Preserved copy: [https://web.archive.org/web/20261009184033/https://res.starwarsccg.org/Resources/swccgcardlist4.0.pdf Internet Archive].[https://res.starwarsccg.org/Resources/Star_Wars_CCG_Collecting_Encyclopedia_3.2.pdf SWCCG Collecting Encyclopedia 3.2], Reflections product entry (collecting reference). Preserved copy: [https://web.archive.org/web/20261008192828/https://res.starwarsccg.org/Resources/Star_Wars_CCG_Collecting_Encyclopedia_3.2.pdf Internet Archive]. It is a foil printing of the [[A New Hope]] card.[[:File:Reflections-Foil-L-Attack-Run-PSA-72605733-original.jpg|Original printed Reflections foil face]], PSA certification 72605733. |game_text=Deploy on Death Star: Trench.
During your move phase, you may make an Attack Run as follows:
'''Enter Trench:''' Move up to 3 of your starfighters into trench (for free). Dark Side may immediately follow with up to 3 TIEs (for free).
'''Provide Cover:''' Identify your lead starfighter (Proton Torpedoes* required) and wingmen (if any). Turbolaser Batteries and TIEs with weapons may now target your starfighters (wingmen first, then lead if no wingmen remaining). Hit starfighters are immediately lost.
'''It’s Away!:''' Draw two destiny.
'''Pull Up!:''' All starfighters now move to Death Star system (for free).
If (total destiny + X + Y - Z) > 15, Death Star is “blown away.”
X = ability of lead pilot or 3 if Targeting Computer is present.
Y = total sites at largest Rebel Base (Yavin 4 or Hoth).
Z = highest ability of TIE pilots in trench.
*Your Proton Torpedoes are immune to Overload. |versions='''Decipher''' — [[Attack Run]] (2_42o)
